alibabacloud-oss-manage-metaquery 0.0.2

- Raised minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement from 3.3.1 to 3.3.3.
- Enforced use of "AI-mode" for all CLI invocations: must enable AI-mode at workflow start and disable it at every exit point.
- Required all Aliyun CLI commands to include the specific user-agent "AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-oss-manage-metaquery".
- Updated installation and verification instructions for Aliyun CLI and plugin management.
- Clarified and strengthened operational safety rules and workflow requirements.
